text.content:
name: techvault-bounded-native
version: 1.0.0
description: Bounded TechVault libvirt substrate used to certify exact VM/network
  realization without guest image, placement, service, ACL, or SOC claims.
nodes:
  lab:
    type: switch
  demo:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 134217728
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
    services: []
infrastructure:
  lab:
    properties:
      cidr: 192.0.2.0/24
      gateway: 192.0.2.1
      internal: true
  demo:
    links:
    - lab
